title: Student Transportation Services Courtesy Permit Rates by School Level, 2026-27
content:
The school-level table of the Student Transportation Services courtesy permit fee schedule sets the period rate of a courtesy rider permit by the rider's grade. The rider's grade is the grade on the student's latest-registered district enrollment record for the school year in Student Enrollment, Transfers and Pre-Kindergarten Admissions (the latest by registration date); a student with no such record has no grade.

| Rider's grade | Period rate, Courtesy Rider Permit (Annual) | Period rate, Courtesy Rider Permit (Semester) |
|---|---|---|
| KG, 01, 02, 03, 04 or 05 | 216.00 USD | 121.50 USD |
| 09, 10, 11 or 12 | 264.00 USD | 148.50 USD |
| any other grade (PK3, PK4, 06, 07, 08), or no grade | the type's permit fee in the fee table, 240.00 USD | the type's permit fee in the fee table, 135.00 USD |

## Reading the record (hypothetical riders)

- A student with two district enrollment records for the school year, registered on different dates, is rated by the grade on the one registered later.
- A seventh grader on a semester permit is rated at 135.00.
- A student with no district enrollment record for the school year has no grade and is rated at the type's permit fee.
- A tenth grader on an annual permit is rated at 264.00; a fifth grader at 216.00.
